last=None

 global px,py,ang,last,pts
 t=o['t']; dt=o['dt']; v=o['motion']['v_mps']
 w=v*math.tan(math.radians(o['steer_deg']))/2.5
 if last is not None:
  px+=v*math.cos(ang+w*dt/2)*dt; py+=v*math.sin(ang+w*dt/2)*dt; ang+=w*dt
 last=t
 c=math.cos(ang); s=math.sin(ang)
 for name,view in o['views'].items():
  if name=='periphery' or not view: continue
  ox,oy=view['origin']
  for b,d in view.get('walls',[]):
   if d>22: continue
   b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
   pts.append((px+c*x-s*y,py+s*x+c*y,t))
 pts=[p for p in pts if t-p[2]<12]
 h=math.radians(o['hitch_deg']); rx,ry=o['rig']['trailer_rear']
 tx=rx-3.5
 sides=[[],[]]
 for X,Y,T in pts:

  if abs(off)<0.7 or abs(off)>6: continue

  sides[0 if off>0 else 1].append((x,y,wt))

  sw=sum(z[2] for z in a)
  if sw<0.1:return None
  mx=sum(x*w for x,y,w in a)/sw; my=sum(y*w for x,y,w in a)/sw
  den=sum(w*(x-mx)**2 for x,y,w in a)
  slope=sum(w*(x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y,w in a)/max(0.2,den)
  return my+slope*(tx-mx)
